Title: Admins see Microsoft Teams usage reports not being updated since September 1, 2026, in the Microsoft 365 admin center

User impact: Admins see Microsoft Teams usage reports not being updated since September 1, 2026, in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

Current status: We've received reports from your representatives that the impact scenario documented in MO1476333 is still ongoing. We're reviewing the latest reports of impact to further our understanding of the current impact scenario and to determine our next troubleshooting steps. 

Scope of impact: Your organization is affected by this event, and your admins don’t see updated Microsoft Teams usage reports in the Microsoft 365 admin center since September 1, 2026. This section may be updated as the investigation progresses.

Next update by: Tuesday, September 29, 2026, at 5:00 PM UTC

Title: Admins may see multiple usage report types experiencing varying delays in the Microsoft 365 admin center

User impact: Admins may see multiple usage report types experiencing varying delays in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

More info: Due to the delay in data propagation, impacted usage reports may not be viewable.

The following usage report types are delayed since September 19, 2026:
-	Microsoft Teams usage reports
-	Microsoft 365 Group Activity reports
-	Mailbox usage reports
The following report types are delayed since September 23, 2026:
-	Email Activity reports
-	Email Apps usage reports
-	Active User reports
-	Copilot Readiness reports
-	Microsoft 365 Apps usage reports

Current status: After further review, we've validated that more tenants are impacted than initially diagnosed, and we've expanded communications to all potentially affected tenants. We've updated the "Title", "User impact", and "Scope of impact" fields of our communications to reflect this change and we've outlined the delayed usage report types in the "More info" section of this communication. We're analyzing delayed report types to isolated potential discrepancies and to determine our next troubleshooting steps.

Scope of impact: Some admins may not see updated usage reports in the Microsoft 365 admin center with varying delays. This section may be updated as the investigation progresses.

Current status: We've identified that there are multiple issues impacting different groups of usage report types in the Microsoft 365 admin center. We're working to isolate all underlying causes of impact, and at this time, we're aware of a code issue occurring within an upstream dependency service that's causing impact to a portion of the affected reports.
